channel.title: Simple Product Picks - USB-C Adapters UK
channel.description: Buying guides for USB-C to HDMI, DisplayPort, ethernet and audio adapters. Every link verified against the live Amazon listing.

item.title: Best USB C To HDMI Adapter 2026
item.description: HDMI is the socket TVs, projectors and meeting-room screens actually have. Three USB-C to HDMI picks, from a direct 4K 60Hz cable to a full docking hub.

item.title: Best USB C To DisplayPort Adapter 2026
item.description: Drive a high-refresh or 8K monitor from a USB-C laptop. Three USB-C to DisplayPort adapters and cables compared on version, resolution ceiling and length.

item.title: Best USB C To Aux Adapter 2026
item.description: Keep wired earphones or a car aux lead working on a phone with no headphone socket. Three USB-C to 3.5mm adapters compared on DAC, controls and build.

item.title: Best USB C Ethernet Adapter UK 2026
item.description: Also sold as a USB-C network adapter or Ethernet dongle - same device. Three UK picks across Gigabit, 2.5G and 5G, and a plain answer to which speed you need.

item.title: Best USB C SD Card Reader 2026
item.description: A UHS-I reader cannot beat the card's own speed limit. Three USB-C SD card readers compared: a CF-friendly 4-in-1, a phone-charging all-rounder and a UHS-II pick.

item.title: Does A USB-C Ethernet Adapter Slow Your Internet
item.description: A gigabit adapter carries 1000 Mbit/s, more than most home lines use. Where the real ceiling sits, when 2.5G is worth it, and why wired feels steadier than Wi-Fi.

item.title: Best USB-C Ethernet Adapter for iPad 2026
item.description: Any USB-C iPad takes a plain Ethernet adapter with no app, no driver and no hub. Gigabit is plenty on an iPad; here are three picks and when each one fits.

item.title: UHS-I vs UHS-II SD Cards Explained
item.description: How to tell a UHS-I SD card from a UHS-II one at a glance, what the bus-speed and the U and V class numbers measure, and why the card and reader must match.
